customHead:
<style>
   
  /* Search Header Wrap */ 
  .container-fluid .row-fluid .search-header-wrap {
    background: #f6f6f6;
    text-align: center;
    padding: 50px 0;
  } 
  
  .container-fluid .row-fluid .search-header-wrap .page-width {
    float: none;
    max-width: 690px;
    margin: 0 auto;
    padding: 0 20px;
  }
   
  .container-fluid .row-fluid .search-header-wrap .header {
    margin-bottom: 20px;
    background: none;
    padding: 0;
    position: static;
  }

  .container-fluid .row-fluid .search-header-wrap .header, 
  .container-fluid .row-fluid .search-header-wrap .header * {
    font-size: 38px;
    line-height: 1.2;
    font-weight: 700;
  }

  .hs-search-field {
    position: relative;
  }

  .container-fluid .row-fluid .search-header-wrap .hs-search-field__input {
    -webkit-appearance: none;
    max-width: 420px;
    margin-right: auto;
    margin-left: auto;
    padding-right: 20px;
    padding-left: 20px;
    border-radius: 50px;
    font-size: 18px;
    border: 0;
    padding: 10px 18px;
    vertical-align: middle;
    background-color: #fff;
    border: 1px solid #ccc;
    line-height: 1.5;
  }

  .container-fluid .row-fluid .search-header-wrap .hs-search-field__input:focus {
    outline: 0;
  }
  
  .hs-search-field__suggestions {
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    list-style: none;
  }
  
  .hs-search-results__pagination a:empty {
    display: none;
  }
  
  .hs-search-results__description {
    font-size: 16px;
    line-height: 1.4em;
    color: #414141;
  }
  
  .hs-search__no-results * {
    font-size: 16px;
    line-height: 1.5;
  }
  
  .search-header-wrap h1{
    color: #002D56;
    padding-bottom: 5px;
    margin: 0;
  }
  
  @media (max-width: 767px) {
    
    .container-fluid .row-fluid .search-header-wrap .header, 
    .container-fluid .row-fluid .search-header-wrap .header * {
      font-size: 25px;
    }
    
  }
  
  /* Search Result Wrap */
  .container-fluid .row-fluid .search-result-wrap {
    padding: 50px 0;
    background: #fff;
    min-height: 100vh;
  }
  
  .container-fluid .row-fluid .search-result-wrap .page-width {
    float: none;
    max-width: 850px;
    margin: 0 auto;
    padding: 0 20px;
  }
  
  .hs-search-results__listing {
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    list-style: none;
  }
  
  .hs-search-results__listing li {
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
  }
  
  .container-fluid .row-fluid .search-result-wrap .hs-search-results__listing li {
    padding: 25px 20px;
    border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.1);
    -webkit-transition: all 200ms ease;
    transition: all 200ms ease;
  }
  
  .container-fluid .row-fluid .search-result-wrap .hs-search-results__listing li:hover {
    padding-left: 24px;
    color: #87946B;
  }
  
  .container-fluid .row-fluid .search-result-wrap .hs-search-results__listing li:hover a {
    color: #87946B;
  }
  
  .container-fluid .row-fluid .search-result-wrap .hs-search-results__listing li a {
    color: #212529;
    text-decoration: none;
  }
  
  .container-fluid .row-fluid .search-result-wrap .hs-search-results__listing li .hs-search-results__title {
    font-size: 32px;
    line-height: 1.2;
/*     margin-bottom: 10px; */
    display: inline-block;  
    color: #002D56;
  }
   
  
  .container-fluid .row-fluid .search-header-wrap .hs-search-field--open .hs-search-field__suggestions {
    max-width: 300px;
    margin: 0 auto;
    border: 0;
  } 
  
  .hs-search-field__suggestions a, .hs-search-field__suggestions #results-for {
    display: block;
  }
  
  .container-fluid .row-fluid .search-header-wrap .hs-search-field--open .hs-search-field__suggestions a {
    text-decoration: none;
    color: #94d11a;
  }
  
  .hs-search-results__next-page {
    float: right;
  }
  
  .hs-search-results__pagination{
    padding-top: 30px;
  }
  .hs-search-results__pagination a{
    color: #fff;
    text-decoration: none;
    background-color: #002D56;
    padding: 14px 15px;
    border-radius: 4px;
    -webkit-transition: all 200ms ease;
    -o-transition: all 200ms ease;
    transition: all 200ms ease;
  }
  .hs-search-results__pagination a:hover{
    -webkit-transform: translate(0px, -2px);
    -ms-transform: translate(0px, -2px);
    transform: translate(0px, -2px);
  }
  
  
  @media (max-width: 767px) {
    
    .container-fluid .row-fluid .search-result-wrap .hs-search-results__listing li .hs-search-results__title {
      font-size: 23px;
    } 
    .hs-search-results__pagination a{
      padding: 12px 12px;
      font-size: 15px;
    }
    .container-fluid .row-fluid .search-result-wrap{
      padding: 20px 0 50px;
    }
    .container-fluid .row-fluid .search-header-wrap .hs-search-field__input{
      font-size: 16px;
    }
    
  }
    
</style>
